maddeler.e:
تشلين (form I)
# تَشَلِّينَ (tašallīna) /ta.ʃal.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of شَلَّ (šalla)
# تَشُلِّينَ (tašullīna) /ta.ʃul.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of شَلَّ (šalla)
# تُشَلِّينَ (tušallīna) /tu.ʃal.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of شَلَّ (šalla) and شُلَّ (šulla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
